title: Invite 3 Active Members
description: Apne referral link se 3 naye members ko join karwayein jo apna account verify karein.
requirement: Team tree section ka screenshot support handler ko bhejein.

title: Watch 30 Image Ads
description: Image Ads tab mein jakar aik din ke andar 30 ads mukammal dekhein.
requirement: Watched ads counter ka screenshot share karein.

title: Tap Tap Miner Milestone
description: Tap Tap Coin game mein aik din ke andar apne saare daily taps mukammal karein.
requirement: Tap tap counter ka screenshot proof ke taur par bhejein.

title: Social Media Status Share
description: ProJoin app ki promotional image ya link apne WhatsApp status par lagayein.
requirement: Status ka screenshot 24 ghantay ke andar send karein.

title: Facebook Group Promotion
description: Kisi bhi bade online earning ya crypto Facebook group mein ProJoin share karein.
requirement: Post ka link ya screenshot proof ke tor par bhejein.

title: Complete All Daily Surveys
description: Task Center mein maujuda teeno daily surveys ko aik sath mukammal karein.
requirement: Completed surveys status ka screenshot share karein.

title: Reels Task Enthusiast
description: Reels Task tab mein jakar aik din ki limit (15 reels) mukammal dekhein.
requirement: Reels counter 15/15 ka screenshot submit karein.

title: Video Guide Feedback
description: Guide & Video Tutorials tab se dono tutorial videos mukammal watch karein.
requirement: Video player completion ka screenshot WhatsApp par bhejein.

title: Video Tutorials Watcher
description: App ke Guide section mein maujuda dono official tutorial videos mukammal dekhein.
requirement: Guide video player screen ka screenshot bhejein.

title: Active Chat Participant
description: Community chat ya support group mein active rahen aur sawal puchein.
requirement: Chat interaction ka screenshot submit karein.

title: Feedback & Suggestion
description: App ko behtar banane ke liye admin ko apni qeemti raaye dein.
requirement: Admin ya WhatsApp handler ko bhege gaye message ka screenshot dein.
